'''atack-of-the-clones Walker Garrison with AATs (MISC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[atack-of-the-clones]]
* '''Published:''' 14 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Hoth Ice Plains (5th Marker) atack-.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The ultimate in combat vehicle decks.

== Strategy ==

Pretty Simple, you do get enough force (easily), so just blow them away in big battles.  There also are many cards to destroy enemies before the battle, use them when you can.  Don't always worry about battle destiny, you're imunnity should usually hold you up.
